newsitem.title: USA: Shoney's turnaround has made progress.
newsitem.headline: Shoney's turnaround has made progress.

text.p: Shoney's Inc said Friday its turnaround has made significant progress, stating comparable sales and customer satisfication trends indicate improvement at its Shoney's Restaurants operations.

It reported revenues for the third quarter ended August 4 increased one percent to $257.0 million and comparable restaurant sales were up 0.5 percent, including a menu price increase of 2.1 percent. Comparable restaurant sales for the company's Shoney's Restaurants were down 0.7 percent, while the company's Captain D's restaurants had a comparable restaurant sales increase of 5.3 percent.
It said profits from continuing operations dropped to $6.6 million, or $0.16 per share, in the latest quarter from $8.2 million, or $0.20 per share, in the third quarter last year.

Chief executive C. Stephen Lynn said, "We have made significant progress in our turnaround. The trends in comparable restaurant sales and customer satisfaction scores indicate we are improving operational execution at our Shoney's Restaurants."
Lynn said, "Our operational focus for the Shoney's Restaurants over the last several months has been the middle Tennessee market.

"I am pleased to report the middle Tennessee market has reported positive comparable restaurant sales for 19 of the 21 weeks in the period ending August 25, 1996, with an overall comparable restaurant sales increase for that period of 3.5 percent. Further, those results exceed the comparable restaurant sales reported for all other company-owned Shoney's Restaurants for that same period by 5.2 percent.

"Additional evidence of our operational improvement is our customer satisfaction scores for company-owned Shoney's Restaurants which have increased by 16 percent since the beginning of the fiscal year."
